statements.text: Note - keep mind everyone it has to reject hard of that grey zone just like it did last 2 times or I'm out

chart.symbol: BTCUSD (chart title 'Bitcoin/USD Tether Perpetual C...', footer ticker 'BTCUSD')
chart.venue: TradingView (mobile app); instrument is a USDT perpetual, underlying exchange not shown

level tag; only a ~10px red fragment visible at the right edge
major pivot/support - full-width SOLID GREEN horizontal line, the price broke up through it in early March and it has held as support since
level tag; only a ~20px fragment visible at the right edge
level tag only - no line segment visible inside the plotted window
lower horizontal line - full-width cyan DASHED line, near the early-March low
level tag immediately under 62,694.3; only a ~20px fragment visible

drawn_objects: SHORT position tool at the right edge (pink stop box above, teal target box below): ENTRY 74,428.4 (grey tag), STOP 74,939.5 (red tag, top of pink box), TARGET 71,172.9 (teal tag, bottom of teal box). Risk ~511 pts, reward ~3,256 pts, R:R ~6.4:1. Verified by pixel-mapping the box edges onto the price axis (pink box 74,939->74,428; teal box 74,428->71,15x).

Grey horizontal ZONE / band spanning ~73,774 to ~74,577 (the 'grey zone' he names in the 19:25 message), with the cyan dashed 74,577.3 line on its top edge and the teal 73,773.7 tag on its bottom edge. Price is currently trading inside this band.

Large hand-drawn black UP arrow running from the early-March low (bottom-left, ~62-63k area) diagonally up to a tip at approximately 79,100 - i.e. the rally he says already happened / is still running.
Hand-drawn black DOWN arrow inside the teal target box, starting at the grey zone and pointing down to the bottom of the target box (~71.1k) - the pullback he is projecting.
Short hand-drawn black up-sloping trendline under the most recent leg up (mid-chart, around the 71-72k swing low).
Green dotted horizontal line at the live price 74,279.6 with bar countdown 01:49:29 (this is TradingView's last-price line, NOT a level he drew).
Purple lightning-bolt icon on the time axis (TradingView marker).
chart.visible_date_range: Day-of-month ticks 10, 13, 16 and 19 are printed on the time axis; month/year are not printed. Given the 17/03/2026 post date and 2H candles the visible window runs approximately 7 March to 20 March 2026, the right-hand portion being empty future space into which the position tool projects.
chart.what_the_drawing_says: He is long-biased on the completed move (big up arrow off the early-March low through the green 69,011.1 pivot) but is now flagging a short-term rejection: price has pushed into a grey supply zone at ~73,774-74,577 and he has a short position tool set at entry 74,428.4, stop 74,939.5, target 71,172.9 (~6.4:1 R:R). The 19:25 caption makes the trade conditional - the grey zone must 'reject hard' as it did on the two previous touches, otherwise he abandons the idea. The cyan dashed lines at 82,490.4 and 62,694.3 bracket the wider range and the solid green 69,011.1 line is the level he treats as the trend pivot.

claims: Note - keep mind everyone it has to reject hard of that grey zone just like it did last 2 times or I'm out
notes: Every price-axis tag was read from a 5x upscale of the axis column, then INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED by pixel-calibrating the axis: the grey gridlines are exactly 87px apart per 2,000 price units, giving price(y) = 82,000 - (y-640)*22.989. Under that mapping the pink box top lands on 74,933 (tag 74,939.5), the pink/teal boundary on 74,403 (tag 74,428.4), the teal box bottom on 71,149 (tag 71,172.9), the solid green line on 69,023 (tag 69,011.1), and the two cyan dashed lines on 82,494 and 62,686 (tags 82,490.4 and 62,694.3) - all within ~1px. This is why the position tool is reported as a short with entry 74,428.4 / stop 74,939.5 / target 71,172.9 rather than guessed. IMPORTANT: TradingView shifts overlapping axis labels vertically, so the tag y-positions in the crowded 74.2-74.9k cluster do NOT equal their true price rows; the gridline calibration above was used instead. The grey axis values 82,000.0 / 80,000.0 / 78,000.0 / 72,000.0 / 70,000.0 / 66,000.0 / 64,000.0 are plain gridlines and are deliberately EXCLUDED from drawn_levels. 74,279.6 is the live last-price tag (it carries the 01:49:29 bar countdown) and is likewise recorded as chart.last_price, not as a drawn level. Tags 80,905.2, 69,361.4, 68,051.6, 65,174.3 and 62,656.5 have no (or only a <25px) visible line inside the plotted window - the objects they belong to sit outside the visible x-range - so their roles are left unresolved rather than invented. The hand-drawn arrow tip price (~79,100) is approximate: it is a freehand stroke, not a snapped object. AMBIGUITY: in the 19:25 message the digit in 'last 2 times' is roughly 70% covered by the app's jump-to-bottom button; the visible top curve and baseline stroke read as '2' and a '3' fits poorly, but it is not 100% certain. The 18:24 message and its chart are the same ones that appear truncated at the bottom of IMG_7806 (consecutive scroll). Exchange venue for the perpetual is not shown - the chart title is truncated by the app as 'Bitcoin/USD Tether Perpetual C...'. 'PUMPUS' and 'AVAXUS' are partially-visible watchlist tickers bleeding through behind the chart footer, not content.
